title: Battle of Öland
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Öland", at revision 1377123321, opens: "The Battle of Öland was a naval battle between an allied Danish and Dutch fleet and the Swedish navy in the Baltic Sea, off the east coast of Öland on 1 June 1676. The battle was a part of the Scanian War (1675–1679) fought for supremacy over the southern Baltic. Sweden was in urgent need of reinforcements for its north German possessions; Denmark sought to ferry an army to Scania in southern Sweden to open a front on Swedish soil." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q736140, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1676 naval battle between an allied Danish-Dutch fleet and the Swedish navy in the Baltic Sea". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
